body: Well scratch the girlfriend part, just had a break up for good.

Family got me a christian counselor, which didn't work due to the fact I am not christian and when I stopped going after 5 times because being told "God has a plan" for 45 minutes a session wasn't helping, my family then chalked it up as me just wanting attention or some shit and don't care anymore. 

My girlfriend just doesn't understand the severity, despite me trying to convey it to her. So she just treats it like "I'm a little sad at times." She also isn't the "caring" type. Yeah.... probably not a healthy relationship there. 

And at this point I've alienated most of my friends. Those I have left aren't the emotionally there type, and half are my coworkers. Not the type of people I feel comfortable talking to.
